meta.name: mainline_6x30_frozen_router_plan
meta.description: Pre-registered static enterprise-router plan for the 6x30 mainline. Used by enterprise_router_baseline and budgetflow_same_enterprise_router only; BudgetFlow task-level/segment policies use their own value-aware routing under the same shared hard budget.
meta.preferred_model_formula: tier3 if manual_value >= 0.95 or bootstrap_effort >= 300 else tier2
meta.note: No paid mainline outcomes, BudgetFlow results, or T3 solvability probe pass/fail labels are used to set caps. The T3x3 catalog is used at runtime for scarcity diagnostics; this plan only fixes static router caps and preferred-model choices.
meta.staged_execution: Run first 20 tasks, inspect, then resume same out_stem with all 30 ids so completed 20 are skipped and budget ledger/checkpoint state carries forward.
